messages.subject: documentation?
parts:
Hi folks -

I am new at Shiny, and love the concept!  However, I'm having a tough time, even with the tutorials, really digesting how to use it.  For instance, I have a simple app I am trying to build,
that takes data from a user uploaded csv and performs various statistics on the data.  I can see in the tutorials how to upload a data set (it works) and how to plot data (ie, histogram example) but I cannot figure out how to plot the data I just uploaded - ie, how do I reference it once it's been read with read.csv?  

Which leads me to ask - is there any more formal documentation of Shiny, beyond what's in the tutorials on Github?  (one can hope...) 

Also, I am assuming Shiny can make use of R libraries and all the standard functions calls - correct?

Thank you.. and please go easy on this newbie :)

Cynthia

Hi Cyndy, welcome to the community! If you want to upload your ui.R and server.R files to a gist on http://gist.github.com that is probably the easiest way for us to help you.

Also our documentation needs to get better, and that's something we will pour serious effort into later this year.
